metadata.description: The Astound Digital workspace: the project-context knowledge bank (Confluence, Jira, meeting notes, ADRs and specs with citations) for every signed-in user, and the systemprompt admin plugin (admin skills, dashboards, and the systemprompt MCP server). The commons and dev suites return in later stages — full set preserved on the backup/full-marketplace-and-skills branch.

plugins.name: project-context
plugins.description: Project memory for Astound engagements: search Confluence, Jira, meeting notes, ADRs and specs with citations through the knowledge-bank MCP server, plus the skill that teaches an agent to scope every query and weigh hits by authority and date.

plugins.name: astound-admin
plugins.description: Admin-only control plane: who is using the platform, what it costs, what failed, and why. Ships the systemprompt CLI server plus governance, analytics, and operations skills, and three live dashboards.
